_comment: Figures and rules transcribed from the documents in sources/ for data/hra-parameters.json. QSEHRA amounts are keyed by calendar year; excepted benefit HRA and individual coverage HRA rows are keyed by the year a plan year begins.

_sources.usc-26-9831: 26 U.S.C. 9831 (2024 edition), subsection (d)(2)(B)(iii) and (D)(ii), and the Pub. L. 114-255 effective-date note
_sources.n-17-67: IRS Notice 2017-67, footnote 5 and section D, for the indexed 2017 limits

2017.qsehra_source: n-17-67 footnote 5: "This adjustment increased the $10,000 limit to $10,050 for a QSEHRA provided in 2017; the adjustment did not increase the $4,950 limit for 2017." IRC 9831(d)(2)(B)(iii) states $4,950 ($10,000 for family members) and (d)(2)(D)(ii) indexes both for years beginning after 2016 from a 2015 base, rounded down to $50 (usc-26-9831)
2017.planYearHra_source: td-9867: 26 CFR 54.9831-1(c)(3)(viii) and 54.9802-4 apply to plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2020
